head.description: base of skull / neck attachment point

notes: Visible source artwork in body.png and head.png is direct pixel extraction from source.png.
Only a narrow hidden hood/neck band beneath the skull was reconstructed for small head motion.
This skeleton has no eyelids. eyes_closed.png performs a source-aligned magical glow-off blink inside the existing sockets.
No separate spring layer was created because the robe hood is broad and torso-anchored.
